title: User-visible behavior changes need a docstring versionchanged note and a CHANGES.rst entry

note.title: User-visible behavior changes need a docstring versionchanged note and a CHANGES.rst entry
answers: how do I document a behavior change in click
where do changelog entries go in click
note.body:
Convention seen in this PR: when a public function's behavior changes, add `.. versionchanged:: X.Y.Z` with a short one-line description to its docstring, placed above the older versionchanged/versionadded entries (e.g. src/click/termui.py:prompt and confirm).
A reviewer asked for the note to be cut down to a single plain sentence ("A space is no longer appended to the prompt."), so keep these notes short.
Also add a bullet under the "Unreleased" section of CHANGES.rst that ends with `:issue:`N` :pr:`M``, wrapped to the file's line width.
note.applies: Any user-visible behavior change or bug fix in the click public API
